blockers.finding: First-seen output vector always wins, ignoring a later shallower/smaller representative. Ranking can change remaining finite-depth reachability, so mechanisms no longer differ only by exploration order.
blockers.fix: Keep deterministic Pareto representatives in size/depth (and relevant operational error semantics), retire dominated stale frontier entries, and test a deeper-first equivalent followed by a shallower equivalent.

blockers.finding: Visited state marked on enqueue, so an expensive first path can prevent a later cheaper path to identical positions/partcount. Heap alone does not make first enqueue minimal. Current depth4/maxops24 limits may mask some maxops consequences.
blockers.fix: Use best-cost relaxation and skip stale popped states, or finalize only on pop. Add an expensive atom versus cheaper literal convergence regression.
